column3: MT 12:2. Close to the Hebrew; “violence” is rendered “desolation.”
MT 12:3. Close to the Hebrew; “to visit [judgment] on Jacob” is rendered “will punish Jacob.”
MT 12:5. Close to the Hebrew; “an angel” is rendered “the Angel.”
MT 12:6. Close to the Hebrew; “his memorial” is rendered “His memorable name.”
MT 12:7. Close to the Hebrew; “in your God you will return” is rendered “by the help of your God, return,” and “loyalty” “mercy.”
MT 12:8. NKJV renders “Canaan” (also “merchant”) as “A cunning Canaanite!”
MT 12:11. Close to the Hebrew; “by the hand of the prophets I gave parables” is rendered “I have given symbols through the witness of the prophets.”
MT 12:12. Close to the Hebrew; “if Gilead [is] wickedness” is rendered “Though Gilead has idols.”
MT 12:13. Close to the Hebrew; “Aram” is rendered “Syria,” and “for a wife” “for a spouse.”
MT 12:15. Close to the Hebrew; “bitterly” is rendered “most bitterly,” and “his lord” “his Lord.”
